items.borderline: The whole row is sensitive to rule 2's unresolved two-test split. Two chained checks here (hmmsearch, TMalign) pass the authorship test and fail a plan-relative computability test. Resolved the strict way, run4 becomes 10 × 4/6 = 6.5. I used the step-relative reading because that is the one the preserved BASELINE-v2-clean verification upheld, but the key itself records this as an open defect.
